remarks: This beautifully renovated 2 bedroom, 1 bathroom condo offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience. Located in a top-floor, corner unit, this home boasts a sun-drenched living room with gleaming hardwood floors and sliding doors that open to your own private balcony. The open layout includes a spacious dining area and a recently refreshed kitchen. The primary bedroom features a walk-in closet, and the guest bedroom offers ample space. Newly renovated bathroom features beautiful double vanity. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, a newer high-efficiency tankless gas heat & hot water system, two reserved parking spaces, and private basement storage. The complex has been recently updated with new siding, fencing and roofing, lovely landscaping with mature trees, creating a serene and inviting atmosphere. With a low HOA fee, this condo is even more appealing. Situated within walking distance of Metro North, vibrant downtown SONO with its restaurants, nightlife, and shopping, the SONO Mall, the Maritime Aquarium, bus lines, and other major transportation options, this condo truly has it all!
